name: Glance Dock
author: seunghan91
description: A dock of open apps: hover the bar left of the clock to drop one under the pointer, or keep an Apple-style dock on the left, right or bottom edge.

barWidget.description: App icons for the windows in a workspace, shown when you hover the bar left of the clock.

schema.label: Icon size
schema.description: Icons follow the bar size (bar height x 1.08); this scales them by 0.85, 1 or 1.2.

schema.label: Hover delay (ms)
schema.description: How long the pointer rests on the bar before the dock opens.

schema.label: Edge dock
schema.description: A dock of every open app on a screen edge, in addition to the bar hover dock.

schema.label: Edge dock behaviour
schema.description: autohide slides the dock in when the pointer touches the edge; pinned keeps it out and moves tiled windows aside.
